en: These cabins are for the passengers. We crew sleep down in the hold, nearer the engines.
Gentleman Edward: I always book this cabin for the view of the sea. And for the battles, of course.
Gentleman Edward: Splendid. Quite splendid. I shall need another cup of tea.
Burglar Corey: Hey! I wasn't sneaking around the cabins! Er... battle me and forget you saw me!
Burglar Corey: All right, all right! I'll go back to my own cabin.
